topic: 接收器集成与通知模板
title: 真实Webhook超时：短期限下远端已处理仍重试，调整预算并保留恢复通知
answer:
```python
import copy,re
def set_timeout(config,name,duration):
    match=re.fullmatch(r"([1-9][0-9]*)(ms|s)",duration) if isinstance(duration,str) else None
    if not match or not .01<=int(match[1])/(1000 if match[2]=="ms" else 1)<=30:raise ValueError("bounded positive deadline required")
    result=copy.deepcopy(config);rows=[r for r in result["receivers"] if r["name"]==name]
    if len(rows)!=1 or len(rows[0].get("webhook_configs",[]))!=1:raise ValueError("one approved webhook required")
    rows[0]["webhook_configs"][0]["timeout"]=duration
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
过短会让已接收请求被误认为失败而重试，过长会占用发送资源并延迟失败反馈。先测接收端分布，定义幂等与总预算。超时增大不修复接收端永久卡住。

conversion.original_title: 接收器超时设置为什么需结合外部处理时长？

body:
## 操作任务
实现set_timeout(config,name,duration)：深拷贝配置，仅修改指定唯一接收器的唯一webhook.timeout；duration仅允许正整数ms或s且换算后为0.01至30秒，其他值ValueError。原输入、URL、send_resolved及其他路由/接收器均不变。题设受控接收器处理需250ms，先真实观察50ms超时导致远端已开始副作用却收到重试；参考批准1s后同一firing只接受一次，并仍实际收到resolved通知。不能把没有及时ACK解释成对方没有处理，也不能声称延长超时替代业务幂等；本题只验证已知处理时延下的有界预算。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Alertmanager0.28.1 Windows原生重试和真实本地慢HTTP接收器；副作用是私有测试内存事件记录。没有外部工单或生产消息，不声称所有业务时延、故障或恰好一次投递已验证。既有通道HTTP重试题不同，本题直接注入ACK超时并验证恢复通知保留。不改默认身份或服务，不构建镜像。

import copy,datetime,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,threading,time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from notifications_fixture import native,request,wait_for
binary=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
seen=[]
class SlowReceiver(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_POST(self):
  payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])));event=dict(name=payload["alerts"][0]["labels"]["alertname"],status=payload["status"],ack=False);seen.append(event)
  time.sleep(.25)
  try:self.send_response(200);self.send_header("Content-Length","0");self.end_headers();self.wfile.flush();event["ack"]=True
  except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError,ConnectionAbortedError):pass
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
server=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),SlowReceiver);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
def post(base,name,resolved=False):
 now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
 alert=dict(labels=dict(alertname=name),startsAt=(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).isoformat(),endsAt=(now if resolved else now+datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat())
 assert request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",[alert])[0]==200
try:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-webhook-timeout-") as temp:
  root=pathlib.Path(temp);config={"route":{"receiver":"private","group_wait":"0s","group_interval":"1s","repeat_interval":"1h"},"receivers":[{"name":"private","webhook_configs":[{"url":"http://127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port),"send_resolved":True,"timeout":"50ms"}]}]};original=copy.deepcopy(config)
  with native(root/"short",config) as (base,path,proc):
   post(base,"ShortDeadline")
   wait_for(lambda:sum(x["name"]=="ShortDeadline" for x in seen)>=2)
  print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_SHORT_TIMEOUT_RETRIES_AFTER_REMOTE_SIDE_EFFECT_ALREADY_STARTED",flush=True)
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: configure an approved deadline without losing actual recovery notification",flush=True)
  fixed=task.set_timeout(config,"private","1s")
  with native(root/"fixed",fixed) as (base,path,proc):
   post(base,"ApprovedDeadline")
   wait_for(lambda:any(x["name"]=="ApprovedDeadline" and x["status"]=="firing" and x["ack"] for x in seen))
   time.sleep(.8);assert sum(x["name"]=="ApprovedDeadline" and x["status"]=="firing" for x in seen)==1
   post(base,"ApprovedDeadline",resolved=True)
   wait_for(lambda:any(x["name"]=="ApprovedDeadline" and x["status"]=="resolved" and x["ack"] for x in seen))
  expected=copy.deepcopy(original);expected["receivers"][0]["webhook_configs"][0]["timeout"]="1s";assert fixed==expected and config==original
  try:task.set_timeout(config,"private","0s")
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError("unbounded/zero timeout accepted")
  print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_APPROVED_TIMEOUT_ONE_FIRING_ACCEPTED_AND_SEND_RESOLVED_PRESERVED",flush=True)
finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
